title: SpectraFit-Core-Reproducibility: every published result of spectrafit-core 0.1.2, regenerated from the release
description:
A pinned, thin consumer of the spectrafit-core release that regenerates the NIST StRD agreement tables, the figures and the timing comparison reported in the SoftwareX article on spectrafit-core, on a recorded host (terra, Linux x86-64), and checks every number stated in the text against the regenerated data. The compiled library is the published PyPI wheel; the harness and the figure scripts come from the release tag.

Version 1.1.0 adds the timing benchmark of record, measured on terra on 6 and 7 October 2026 with the spectrafit-core 0.1.2 wheel and the v0.1.2 harness: 160 cases on six backends at five repetition depths, a 50-seed catalogue sweep, cross-backend parameter agreement and the serialisation-bias audit, with full per-run payloads and provenance. The 151-case archive measured before the release is kept and labelled as superseded.
